content.doc_md:
## Tutorials

The GETDATE() function returns the current database system date and time, in a 
'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.mmm' format.

Tip:Also look at theCURRENT_TIMESTAMPfunction.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  GETDATE();

---

GETDATE()
```

## Tutorials

The GETUTCDATE() function returns the current database system UTC date and time, in a 
'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.mmm' format.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  GETUTCDATE();

---

GETUTCDATE()
```

## Tutorials

The ISDATE() function checks an expression and returns 1 if it is a valid date, otherwise 
0.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT ISDATE('2017-08-25');

---

ISDATE(
expression
)

---

SELECT ISDATE('2017');

---

SELECT ISDATE('Hello world!');
```

## Tutorials

The MONTH() function returns the month part for a specified date (a number from 1 to 12).

### Code Examples

```
SELECT MONTH('2017/08/25') AS Month;

---

MONTH(
date
)

---

SELECT MONTH('2017/05/25 09:08') AS Month;
```

## Tutorials

The SYSDATETIME() function returns the date and time of the computer where the SQL Server is running.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT SYSDATETIME() AS SysDateTime;

---

SYSDATETIME()
```
